div.head: X Atr Prol. 2
div.ab: Nu wille ic georne æfter þam spyrian, hu we lara ⁊ laga betst magan healdan ⁊ æghwylce unlaga swyþost aweorpan.
Nu wille ic georne æfter þam spyrian, hu we lara ⁊ laga betst magan healdan ⁊ æghwylce unlaga swyþost aweorpan.
Pr.2 Nu wille ic georne æfter þam spyrian hu we lara and laga betst magan healdan and æghwylce unlaga swyþost aweorpan.
Nun will ich eifrig dem nachspüren, wie wir aufs beste Lehren und Gesetze halten und jegliche Gesetzwidrigkeiten völligst beseitigen können.
Now I will eagerly seek out how we may best keep teachings and laws and most completely cast out every abuse of law.
Now I desire zealously to search out how we may best uphold precepts and laws and most fully renounce all unjust practices.
Pr.2 Now I fervently wish to discover how we might best adhere to the teachings and laws and totally reject all injustice.
